mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona City Hall and a moderate air quality alert in effect.

The city wants to remind you that winter parking rules start November 20, requiring parking on alternating sides of the street overnight, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
There is plenty to do this week, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights starting this Tuesday at multiple local venues.
On October 23, Verona police officers cited the parents of two juveniles who were caught operating e-motorcycles in the street after having previously received warnings.
You can grab the flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, at Culver's today, as they are currently open until 10 PM.
